flags.shared_function: opcg_sim.loop.engine.decide_with_rethink(decide, opts_json, ratio, worlds) — used by both RsGame._decide (API) and driver.run_game (arena/gen seats)
flags.ratio: opcg_sim.loop.engine.rethink_ratio(out) = 2nd / 1st visit count of root groups (merged equal moves)
flags.api_defaults: opcg_sim/loop/engine.py PLAY_RETHINK_RATIO = None (off), PLAY_RETHINK_WORLDS = 4; routers.py passes both
flags.SeatSpec: rethink_ratio=, rethink_worlds= (named args; NOT put into decide opts)
flags.arena_shard: --cand-rethink-ratio / --cand-rethink-worlds (candidate seat, via add_cand_args, so gate.py gets them too); --rethink-ratio / --rethink-worlds (baseline seat; ARENA_RESUME_FINAL gets best_opts when set)
flags.trace: tr['rethink'] = {r, fired, first_move, final_move} only when ratio is not None (moves via describe_move); driver out['rethink'] same with raw moves

gates.make_test: green (cargo 572 passed / 1 ignored; pytest 847 passed / 13 skipped)
gates.new_tests: tests/test_play_rethink.py 9 passed (required tier, no cpu_infra): (a) off identical move+trace, single decide call; (b) tau=0 == worlds=4 decide (move and full trace); (c) tau=1.01 == 1-world decide, and run_game 40 steps same move sequence; (d) trace shape; pure branch tests (window/commit/1 candidate/already K worlds don't fire; re-read changes only worlds)

metrics.command: python tests/scripts/rs_rethink_sweep.py --games 20 --jobs 3 --out sweep.jsonl  (sims 1280, budget 0, K=4, seeds 2999900-2999919, random leaders x synth_roles, both seats r13d)
metrics.machine: 4-core container; 3 worker processes, each pinned to its own core (sched_setaffinity) — K worlds run serially on that one core
metrics.method: positions follow the off seat (1 world x 1280); at every decision the 1-world decide is timed (t1) and, if r >= 0.3, the 4-world decide with the identical opts is timed too (tK). Per tau the per-move time = t1 + (tK if r >= tau). Same positions for every tau.

notes: Base: the instruction says branch from the latest mainline; origin/main is behind (stops at PR #212), so I branched from claude/cpu-spec-improvements-yw91jd@66266aa (the commit that adds §7.4), as n_loop_ops §5 says.

r is read from out['groups'] (equal moves merged; this is the list the played move is chosen from), not from raw stats.N. Decisions with kind != 'main' (battle/dialog window root folds, box commit) and with fewer than 2 groups are not re-read (they don't use worlds, so the re-read would give the same move) — r is None there.
If the seat's opts already have worlds >= K, it does not re-read (it would be the same read again); r is still reported.
When it fires, the whole decide output is replaced (move, stats, groups, commit/resact carry, per_world), so test (b) checks the full trace equals worlds=K.

Off path: decide_with_rethink with ratio None calls decide once with the caller's original opts_json string and returns json.loads of it unchanged (no key added). The API keeps json.dumps(opts); the driver keeps spec.decide_opts(...). SeatSpec does not put rethink_* into opts, so arena ledgers without the new flags look the same as before.

Compute is well above the plan's forecast (×1.3–1.6): fire rate at tau 0.3/0.5 is 28%/20% of all decisions (inside the 15–30% forecast), but the re-read happens only on tree decisions, which are 91% of the time, and a 4-world re-read on one core costs about 4.1× the 1-world read. Result: compute ×3.20 / ×2.57 / ×2.06 / ×1.50 for tau 0.3/0.5/0.7/0.9. Only tau 0.9 is inside the forecast range.

Swap rate (re-read picks a different move) goes up as tau goes up: 17.7% / 19.4% / 23.3% / 27.6% of fired decisions — the closer the top two, the more often 4 worlds change the move. Per decision overall: 4.9% / 3.9% / 3.1% / 1.7%.

Tail: the longest single move is 53.0 s at tau 0.3 and 42.8 s at tau 0.5–0.9 (off: 10.2 s). Off mean here is 0.321 s, vs 0.80 s in 2026-10-18_serve_sims.md; rs-ismcts measured 311 ms on other seeds with the same engine, so the engine got faster since then (not because of this change).

Timing caveat: 3 pinned processes ran at the same time (shared L3/memory bandwidth), so absolute times may be a bit higher than a single process on an idle machine; the ratios between taus share the positions and the machine state.
gate.py's baseline seat is not given rethink options (the instruction only names arena_shard); candidate --cand-rethink-* also reach gate.py through add_cand_args.
Container setup: maturin, pytest, pytest-xdist and opcg_sim/requirements.txt were not installed; I installed them with pip before make rust-develop / make test.

The meter rs_rethink_sweep.py has no test (CLAUDE.md: measure tools get minimal tests); it got a TEST_SPEC §3 row. The §3 row and RESULT.json were written after make test passed; tests read neither (checked by grep).
